subject: Re: EpiHub kickoff: from forecast archive to weekly pipeline
body:
Hi Viktor, Jelena,

Status against the May 22 milestone, plus one risk.

All three hubs are automated: flu-hub since Apr 24, covid19-hub and the RSV target since May 19. Five consecutive weekly flu submissions so far with zero manual fixes. Backtesting against the archived 2025-2026 season shows our refreshed model at a 4% better weighted interval score than the archived baseline on flu, roughly flat on COVID-19 hospitalizations, and 7% worse on RSV.

The RSV gap is the risk. RSV counts are sparse at the jurisdiction level and our quantile tails are too narrow - we're getting 90% interval coverage of about 81%. I want two more weeks to widen the tail calibration before we let RSV forecasts reach partners; shipping miscalibrated intervals to public-health users is the one failure mode we can't walk back.

Proposal for the Jun 12 review: hand off flu and COVID-19 as production, mark RSV as beta pending calibration. Jorge and Giannis concur.

Rafael
